sql: select o.market_ticker, min(f.filled_at)::text first_fill, round(sum(f.quantity)) q, o.limit_price px, (select max(p.end_date) from incentive_programs p where p.market_ticker=o.market_ticker)::text prog_end, round(extract(epoch from ((select max(p.end_date) from incentive_programs p where p.market_ticker=o.market_ticker) - min(f.filled_at)))/3600.0) hrs_before_end from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and o.action='buy' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-05' group by o.market_ticker, o.limit_price order by 2
